subject: Clarifying deadlines
text:
Hi,

Following your earlier reply, I still need a simple update about the deadlines. I am not sure whether the revised date includes only the draft, or whether the final version is also affected. Please state which one applies.

I also want to confirm if the review period starts immediately after submission or only after the file is accepted. If there are two separate dates, list them briefly.

This is only to avoid misreading, not to question the schedule. I can adjust my notes once I know the exact cutoff. Also, if the time zone has changed, mention that.

Thanks
